units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:3">Bets. III, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 25a:4-11">25ᵃ</cite>) <he>לא … במ׳ במוטה</he> (Y. ed. <he>במטה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) he must not bring it to town on a staff or on a barrow.

<cite ref="Sotah 34a:9">Sot. 34ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 13:23">Num. XIII, 23</cite>) <he>ממשמע שנאמר במ׳ וכ׳</he> it being said ‘on a staff’, do I not know that it was carried by two persons?—Pl. <he>מוֹטוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 7:1">Tosef. Ohol. VII, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00207"><he>נִדְבָּךְ</he></cite>; a. e.
